name: Tecnam P-Mentor
summary: Modern Italian two-seat glass-cockpit flight-training airplane with a bubble canopy, fixed spatted tricycle gear and a Rotax engine, now common in US flight schools.

wings: Straight leading edge with clean tips
engines: Single Rotax four-cylinder with a two-blade constant-speed propeller
fuselage: Large bubble canopy over side-by-side seats
Fixed tricycle gear with wheel pants
tail: Horizontal tailplane mounted on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Large bubble canopy over side-by-side seats on a tiny low-wing airplane
Fixed tricycle gear with wheel pants and a small Rotax nose
Modern, clean composite look with a tapered wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA20 has a swept-forward-looking wing with a longer, more rounded canopy and a different tail; the P-Mentor has a straighter wing and a more upright fin.
The SF.260 has tip tanks, retractable gear and a tandem layout; the P-Mentor has side-by-side seats, fixed gear and no tip tanks.
The 152 is a high-wing; the P-Mentor is a low-wing with a bubble canopy.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
